title: Delegated Competent Authorities - Uganda Revenue Authority
text:
# Delegated Competent Authorities
DESIGNATED COMPETENT AUTHORITIES IN TAX MATTERS
AUTORITES COMPETENTES EN MATIERE FISCALE
Exchange of Information (On Request, Spontaneous and Automatic)
Echange de renseignements (Sur demande, Spontanée et Automatique)
Description:
There is one central Competent Authority in Uganda who could request information and from whom information shall be requested by her EOI partner. However, there are also delegated and authorized officials who may either sign on behalf of or act in place of the central Competent Authority when necessary. In addition, there is only one central EOI
service that is responsible for all types of taxes, as well as for each type of exchange
